title:
Represents operation types for calculating storage sizes.
Can be `du` of `df`.
`du` can be used for any directories.
  It may take time to analyze large directories because it scans all subdirectories recursively.
`df` will return the used size and available size for the mounted storage device which is backing the dir.
  `df` reports disk usage for mounted storage devices, not individual directories or files.
  The value is only accurate when the mounted storage device is not being shared across multiple nodes.
  e.g. currently single node app pvc is only used by the single node app itself. So in that case, `df` will reflect the usage for the pvc storage accurately.
The output of df is pre-calculated and cached by the operating system. du is not pre-calculated like df.
Instead, du traverses directories in real-time to compute disk usage.
name: StorageUsageComputeType
